select from order_payment p left join order_product op on op.id = cast(p.product_id as unsigned)
and p.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
and p.student_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
and p.student_phone like concat('%', #{studentPhone}, '%')
and p.prepay_order_no like concat('%', #{prepayOrderNo}, '%')
and p.status = #{status}
order by p.id desc
select from order_payment p left join order_product op on op.id = cast(p.product_id as unsigned) where p.order_no = #{orderNo}

mapper.insert: insert into order_payment (order_no, student_phone, student_name, product_id, order_amount, refunded_amount, prepay_order_no, status, unique_order_no, pay_success_time, created_at, updated_at) values (#{orderNo}, #{studentPhone}, #{studentName}, #{productId}, #{orderAmount}, #{refundedAmount}, #{prepayOrderNo}, #{status}, #{uniqueOrderNo}, #{paySuccessTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update order_payment set status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 'INIT'

update order_payment set status = 'SUCCESS', unique_order_no = #{uniqueOrderNo}, pay_success_time = #{paySuccessTime}, updated_at = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status in ('INIT', 'PROCESSING')
update order_payment set status = 'FAIL', updated_at = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 'INIT'
update prepay_order set order_status = 'PAID', updated_at = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
